title: Unit-normalized point sections on native coefficient systems
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l as in def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension. For every scheme W in universe u, the native point-sections data SectionsModel l E W of def-coef-support-point-sections-data is inhabited. Thus the derived quotient-to-completed sections comparison satisfies its whole-derived unit equation, and finite evaluation satisfies the prescribed unit and every-pair transition equations. Values are towers of modules over the constant coefficient ring; no inverse limit is taken.

proof.text: Use sectionsComparison_exists, the isolated whole-derived scalar square, to supply comparison and comparison_unit. No finite-evaluation conclusion is taken from this lemma.

Form the actual total right derived pairs with their rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ natural transformations. Their universal property follows from the K-injective derivability structure; units are invertible on K-injectives by rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ_eq. Apply the proved generic private coefficientTowerComparison of CoefficientSequenceGlobalSections to ordinaryLevelSections and ordinarySections. Ordinary sections on towers is definitionally termwise ordinaryLevelSections. The theorem gives finite evaluation, its unit equation on every complex and all transition squares. Multiply the unit equation by the inverse evaluation-factor isomorphism to put it in the exact sectionsEvaluationUnit form.

Use the generic coefficientTowerComparison transition equation at (op m), (op n), (homOfLE h).op, which is precisely sectionsEvaluationTransitions. Package these fields with the whole-derived scalar comparison from step 1 to obtain SectionsModel.
